name: znetwork_dplay_receive_pending_messages
description: zNetworkDPlay::ReceivePendingMessages drains pending DirectPlay messages into the shared receive buffer, grows the buffer on DPERR_BUFFERTOOSMALL, and dispatches player or system packets.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zNetwork DirectPlay receive-pump source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48ae70 validates the session-runtime guard, fatal-disconnect -1 return, DirectPlay Receive vtable slot 0x64 call, DPERR_BUFFERTOOSMALL realloc/report/retry path, processed-count and message-budget updates, system-message dispatch for fromPlayer zero, player-packet dispatch for nonzero sender, and loop termination on budget or pump stop.

The native zNetwork receive smoke verifies inactive/fatal guards, buffer growth retry, system-message dispatch through PumpIncomingMessages, player-packet dispatch, processed count, sender forwarding, and receive-buffer capacity update.
